title: Claude Code skills and global rules
subtitle: Markdown skills + Python checks · copied on install · repo → home .claude folder
lede: One copy step gives Claude Code our global rules, 40 tech skills and 27 school skills; build scripts and reviewer skills check what they produce.
why: Every session then follows the same rules for replies, data, secrets and output, and each skill that produces material has a reviewer partner.

does: Sets global rules: replies, questions, local-only output, secrets, read-only queries
Routes each task to one skill: code, review, docs, diagrams, data platforms, school
Checks its own output with build scripts, layout checks and reviewer skills
Logs which skill ran and a self-check after the work
doesnt: Doesn't publish output: only the design skill may send a list you approve to claude.ai/design
Doesn't run warehouse writes: data queries go through read-only notebook cells
Doesn't install itself: the copy step is run by hand
limitations: 7 sūtra-style twins are still byte copies of the full version
Old zip snapshots in tech/ and schule/ lag the folders

items: What
Global rules, skills and hooks for Claude Code, in a full version and a compressed sūtra version.
Why
The same rules and process in every session, instead of repeating them in each chat.
Key idea
One skill, one job; a shared base skill holds rules several skills need, and a reviewer skill checks what a skill produces.
Result
Docs, reviews, briefs, diagrams and school material with the same structure every run, checked before they are handed over.
